title: Coherent inverse-image extension of a constant trivialization
statement: Let $S,P$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $s:P\to S$ a morphism. Let $E:\operatorname{Sh}(S_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathrm{Set})\to\mathrm{Set}$ be a functor, with sets in the same universe as the sheaf values [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $\beta:(\mathrm{id}_P\circ s)^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim} E\circ\underline{(-)}_P$ be a natural isomorphism, where inverse images and their canonical composition comparison $c_{f,g}$ are those of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and constant sheaves and generators $\eta_U(e)$ are given by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there is a family of natural isomorphisms $\alpha_{U,h}:(s\circ h)^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim} E\circ\underline{(-)}_U$ for every scheme $U$ and $h:U\to P$, with $\alpha_{P,\mathrm{id}_P}=\beta$. For every $v:V\to U$, sheaf $F$, etale $W\to U$ and $e\in E(F)$, the composition comparison carries the unit pullback of $\alpha_{U,h,F}^{-1}(\eta_U(e)|_W)$ to $\alpha_{V,h\circ v,F}^{-1}(\eta_V(e)|_{W\times_U V})$, with the associativity transport from $v\circ(h\circ s)$ to $(v\circ h)\circ s$ as in the Lean statement. No field, geometric-point or smallness hypothesis on $E(F)$ is imposed.

proof.text: Use the constant sheafification adjunction [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and compose it with the inverse-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. The composite right adjoint evaluates direct image at the terminal P-neighbourhood. Base change of that neighbourhood is terminal over U, so this is canonically global sections on U. Uniqueness of left adjoints with their unit equation [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] supplies a natural isomorphism gamma_h from h^{-1} constant_P to constant_U. Its unit equation sends pulled generators to equal-valued generators. Restricting from the terminal neighbourhood and using unit naturality proves this formula on every W. The argument applies directly to the full coefficient universe.

proof.text: Transport beta from inverse image along identity composed with s to inverse image along s. Define alpha_{U,h} as the inverse composition comparison c_{s,h}^{-1}, followed by h^{-1}(beta), followed by gamma_h, with functor associators. All factors are natural isomorphisms in F.

proof.text: For h = identity, the identity inverse-image adjunction and the unit equations identify this composite with beta. Indeed, the inverse-image identity comparison and gamma_identity carry the corresponding units to themselves; uniqueness in the inverse-image adjunction and [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] gives equality of those morphisms, including the identity-composition transport.

proof.text: For v:V to U, substitute the composite formula for both alpha inverses. Clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] pastes the two inverse-image comparisons with the displayed associativity transport. Clause (0) moves the pullback of beta across the inverse-image unit. The two gamma composites have the same unit equation on each constant generator; uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] or in the sheafification adjunction equates them. Evaluating the equality at the base-changed W gives the required generator identity.

theorem etaleConstantTrivializationPullback
    (S P : Scheme.{u}) (s : P ⟶ S)
    (E : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) ⥤ Type (u + 1))
    (β : Scheme.etaleSetPullback (𝟙 P ≫ s) ≅
      E ⋙ constantSheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    ∃ α : ∀ (U : Scheme.{u}) (h : U ⟶ P),
      Scheme.etaleSetPullback (h ≫ s) ≅
        E ⋙ constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)),
      α P (𝟙 P) = β ∧
      ∀ (U V : Scheme.{u}) (h : U ⟶ P) (v : V ⟶ U)
        (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
        (W : U.Etale) (e : E.obj F),
        (((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2)
          S U V (h ≫ s) v).hom.app F).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v) (Type (u + 1))
            (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (h ≫ s)).obj F)).hom.app (op W)
            (((α U h).inv.app F).hom.app (op W)
              ((toSheafify U.smallEtaleTopology
                ((Functor.const U.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
                  (E.obj F))).app (op W) e))) =
        (((α V (v ≫ h)).inv.app F ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun k : V ⟶ S => (Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F)
            (Category.assoc v h s))).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W)))
          ((toSheafify V.smallEtaleTopology
            ((Functor.const V.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
              (E.obj F))).app
                (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W)) e)
